title: Lost Mary Maryliq Blackcurrant Apple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Unveil a world of fruity goodness with Lost Mary Maryliq's Blackcurrant Apple e-liquid. This captivating blend marries the tart notes of Blackcurrant with the juicy sweetness of fresh Apple, creating a balanced yet complex flavour profile that's sure to please the palate. It's a duo of fruits that beautifully complement each other, offering a vaping experience that's equally refreshing and satisfying. With a 50% VG / 50% PG mix, you're in for a smooth throat hit, robust flavour, and consistent cloud production, making it an excellent choice whether you're new to vaping or a seasoned enthusiast.
